envelope.reason: an assayer asked for a ruling beside pre-call-refusal-holds

payload.title: turn-end guard waves a refused stop through on retry
payload.body: Ruling: the turn end is outside 'a refused act stays refused'. Refusing an act holds back its effect; refusing a turn end holds back nothing, it makes the agent redo its turn, and a guard that could refuse a turn end forever would lock the session with no way out. So the turn-end guard may let a repeated or thrice-blocked stop through, provided it says so. Enter this into enforcement scope once guard-precision closes (held: the plan realizes that shard).
